{{Quote|We are keepers of the wisdom of the Jedi. We maintain the Great Library, we oversee the teachings of the younglings, and we seek out the ancient histories and Holocrons that will bring us greater knowledge of the light side of the Force. But we are more than just caretakers. We are also guardians.|Master Obba explaining the duty of the Council of First Knowledge|<ref name="DoE">''[[Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil]]''</ref>}}
The '''Council of First Knowledge''' was one of the four [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Councils]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] in operation during the rule of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The Council of First Knowledge met in the [[First Knowledge Council Chamber|Council Chambers]] atop the [[Tower of First Knowledge/Legends|northwest tower]] of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==Overview==
The Council of First Knowledge was made up of five [[Jedi Master/Legends|Masters]] selected to oversee the [[Jedi academy]] and the proliferation of knowledge and its storage in the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Temple Archives]]. Additionally, the Council accepted the responsibility of eradicating any trace of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] teachings and their [[Sith artifact/Legends|artifacts]] throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It met in the circular [[First Knowledge Council Chamber|Council Chamber]] at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. Membership on the Council was granted through appointment after a vote of all members. A single permanent member sat for life or until stepping down, and was known as the [[Caretaker of First Knowledge/Legends|Caretaker of First Knowledge]], for this Jedi personally oversaw the protection of the [[Holocron Chamber]] located in the spire. The other four Masters rotated out after serving a five-[[Standard year/Legends|year]] term. Members of the Council often served on one of the other Councils simultaneously, or had retired from the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|High Council]] and retained their membership.<ref name="TCWCG" />

Maintaining the academy went hand in hand with preserving the knowledge banks at the Temple; if the base of knowledge did not constantly grow, the academy could not evolve and progress. Having direct oversight of the [[Librarian's Assembly]], the Archives were presided over by a [[Chief Librarian/Legends|Chief Librarian]], who sometimes sat on the Council themselves. Public contact with the Council was restricted to archive acquisitions and special requests from the public or government agencies. Members of the Council were granted access to the [[Holocron Vault/Legends|Holocron Vaults]] located within the Archives, a highly secured set of chambers used to protect the ancient [[Holocron/Legends|holocrons]] and their secrets. While working with [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiates']] schooling, the Council was not inaccessible to older Jedi needing a different perspective on a dilemma. The Council could be queried for assistance on troubling topics that needed analysis by individuals who had experienced many missions and problems in their lifetimes; members of this Council were often of long-lived [[Species/Legends|species]], though this was not a requirement.<ref name="TJP" /><ref>[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook'']]</ref>

Following the [[New Sith Wars]], the Council dedicated itself and its [[Jedi Shadow|shadow agents]] to the recovery of Sith artifacts. Deeming the possession of such material illegal, agents of the Council were sent out to virtually eradicate all traces of the Sith. They were responsible for the near elimination of [[Darth Andeddu]] from all text found within the Republic. Agents serving the Council worked primarily in the Tower of First Knowledge, consulting holocrons and making use of specialized chambers to seek out [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark-side]] activity. During the years in which this activity was concentrated, Knights working for the Council included many Jedi including [[Medd Tandar]], [[Ma'ya]], [[Pendo]], [[Winnoa]], and [[Set Harth]]. Before turning to the dark side, Harth stole several of the artifacts that the Order sent him to retrieve, hiding them in [[Set Harth's mansion|his estate]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]].<ref name="DoE" /> During the end of the Republic's [[Golden Age of the Old Republic|Golden Age]], it successfully resolved the [[E9D8 Rebellion]] and the [[Vestas Ruling]].<ref name="PotJS">''[[Power of the Jedi Sourcebook]]''</ref>

The earliest known members of the Council include the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Obba]]<ref name="DoE" /> and [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Restelly Quist/Legends|Restelly Quist]], the latter of whom served as Caretaker and Chief Librarian simultaneously.<ref name="TJP" /> Centuries later the rugged and scarred [[Lannik (species)/Legends|Lannik]] Master [[Even Piell/Legends|Even Piell]] retired from his duties on the High Council and opted to sit on the Council of First Knowledge during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="CNI">''[[Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight]]''</ref> While history is foggy on which Council Master [[T'un]] was a member of, his position as [[Curator of Records]] suggests he may have sat on the First Knowledge Council.<ref name="TUP">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Uncertain Path]]''</ref>

The Council of First Knowledge existed nearly continuously throughout the history of the Order, until the end of the Clone Wars, when the Republic was dissolved and [[Declaration of a New Order|reorganized]] into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. With a [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] at the helm of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], the Council was caught unaware when [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] issued [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] and began the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]]. Following the [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|fall]] of the Jedi Temple, the members of the Council were hunted down and killed or fled into self-imposed exile.<ref name="ROTS" />
